# 太上老君清靜心經

**Custom ID:** ZB5f0003

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Most High Lord Lǎo's Heart-Scripture of Purity and Stillness*

Anonymous; Táng-Sòng

A Daoist **heart-scripture** (*xīn jīng* 心經) — short meditation scripture in the tradition of the famous *Cháng qīng jìng jīng* ([KR5c0252](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0252)). Preserved as **DZ 1169** / CT 1169 (Tài qīng bù 太清部).

**Dating.** Táng-Sòng. Dynasty: 唐-宋.
